<!--
Measured, not read: table-spacing written on one table sets that table's
rows and leaves the others at the document's, double here. The first table
asks for single spacing on its caption; the second, a table without a
caption, asks for one-and-a-half on the cell around it, which is where a
chunk option lands (#| table-spacing: onehalf); the third asks for nothing;
the fourth asks for single spacing on a div float around it, whose content
is the table itself.
-->

| Headword | Column B                      |
|:---------|:------------------------------|
| Sinone   | 1                             |
| Sintwo   | 2                             |
| Sinthree | Sinwrap a cell long enough that it has to run on to a second line inside its column of the table sinlater |
